name: Shadow Cipher
ttps_summary: Initial access via spear-phishing with macro-laden Office documents. Lateral movement using PsExec and WMI. Exfiltration via cloud storage abuse (typically MEGA and Backblaze B2).

name: Echo Bear
ttps_summary: Long-dwell-time intrusions, often 8-14 months before exfiltration. Heavy use of living-off-the-land binaries. Custom backdoor 'EchoCall' using DNS tunneling for C2.

name: Glass Hornet
ttps_summary: Supply-chain compromise of npm packages. Targeted developer machines. Ransomware deployment as final stage in ~30% of incidents; pure exfiltration in the remainder.

name: Velvet Mantis
ttps_summary: Mobile-first targeting. Pegasus-class spyware delivered via zero-click iMessage exploits (now patched) and one-click links via WhatsApp. Highly targeted, low-volume campaigns.
